description: This file defines functions and types for formatting and building outbound message delivery data, including summaries and JSON payloads, with references to channel plugins and chat metadata.

methods.name: resolveChannelLabel
methods.description: Resolves a channel string to a human-readable label using plugin metadata or normalized chat channel ID.

methods.name: formatOutboundDeliverySummary
methods.description: Creates a summary string for an outbound delivery result, including channel label and message ID.

methods.name: buildOutboundDeliveryJson
methods.description: Constructs an OutboundDeliveryJson object from given parameters and optional result metadata.

methods.name: formatGatewaySummary
methods.description: Generates a summary string for a gateway action, including optional channel and message ID.
